ability_ref: Ahri E Charm charms and draws an isolated target in, then Pyke Q Bone Skewer hook and E Phantom Undertow stun hold them for the R Death from Below execute.
tr: Ahri E charm, sonra Pyke Q hook + E stun + R execute.

name: Demon Hunt
ability_ref: Evelynn passive (Demon Shade) grants camouflage and Rengar R (Thrill of the Hunt) grants stealth, letting both flank the same isolated carry; Evelynn W (Allure) charms the target (after the curse ramps) to hold it for Rengar's empowered Q (Savagery) leap burst
tr: Cift stealth flank: Eve W charm + Rengar R leap + empowered Q

name: Poison Pit
ability_ref: Amumu R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) entangles (stuns) the whole enemy group in place; Cassiopeia W (Miasma) lays a persistent poison field under them and grounds dash escapes while her Q (Noxious Blast) and E (Twin Fang) stack damage on the stunned targets
tr: Amumu R stun, Cassiopeia W Miasma zehir alani ve grounding ile cururutuyor

name: Adhesive Anchor
ability_ref: Singed W (Mega Adhesive) grounds and slows enemies in the zone while his Q (Poison Trail) burns them; Orianna drops her ball there and follows with R (Command: Shockwave) to pull the slowed, grounded targets into one cluster
tr: Singed W Adhesive yapiskan zemin, Orianna R Shockwave ile yavaslayanlari topluyor

name: Garden Tomb
ability_ref: Amumu R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) entangles (stuns) the enemy group; Zyra plants seeds from Q (Deadly Spines) and W (Rampant Growth), then R (Stranglethorns) knocks up and enrages her plants, which focus-fire the stunned, stationary targets
tr: Amumu R stun, Zyra R Stranglethorns bitkileri ofkelendirip stunlu grubu dover

name: Frostbound Garden
ability_ref: Anivia R (Glacial Storm) creates a persistent slowing, damaging field and her W (Crystallize) wall blocks escape; Zyra layers Q (Deadly Spines) and R (Stranglethorns) plants in the same chokepoint for stacked persistent AoE denial
tr: Anivia R firtinasi + W duvar, Zyra bitkileriyle alan reddi katmanlaniyor

name: Void Cataclysm
ability_ref: Jarvan R (Cataclysm) walls enemies into a small arena; Malzahar drops Q (Call of the Void) and W (Void Swarm) Voidlings plus E (Malefic Visions) inside, the spreading DOT and Voidlings chunking the trapped, grouped enemies
tr: Jarvan R arenasina Malzahar W Swarm + E Visions DOT'u trapped grubu eritiyor

name: Void Wrap
ability_ref: Amumu R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) entangles (stuns) the clustered team; Malzahar E (Malefic Visions) applies a DOT that spreads on death to nearby enemies and his W (Void Swarm) chips the immobile group, with R (Nether Grasp) suppressing a priority target
tr: Amumu R stun sonrasi Malzahar E Visions yayilan DOT, R ile birini suppress

name: Toxic Field
ability_ref: Teemo R (Noxious Trap) creates a field of poisoning, slowing shrooms covering a chokepoint; Cassiopeia W (Miasma) adds an overlapping poison-and-grounding zone so enemies crossing are slowed, poisoned, and unable to dash out
tr: Teemo R mantar tarlasi + Cassiopeia W Miasma, gecen yavaslar ve grounded

name: Poison Gauntlet
ability_ref: Singed W (Mega Adhesive) grounds and slows enemies in a chokepoint while his Q (Poison Trail) burns; Teemo R (Noxious Trap) shrooms in the same lane stack poison and slow, punishing any path through the contested zone
tr: Singed W/Q zehir + Teemo R mantarlari ayni koridorda zehiri katliyor

name: Walled Equalizer
ability_ref: Jarvan R (Cataclysm) traps enemies in a ringed arena; Rumble lays R (The Equalizer) across the enclosed space so the trapped group stands in sustained flamespitter damage they cannot easily walk out of
tr: Jarvan R arenasina Rumble R Equalizer, kacamayan grup surekli yanar

name: Frozen Shrooms
ability_ref: Anivia W (Crystallize) raises a wall that blocks a path and R (Glacial Storm) slows enemies in a persistent field; Teemo R (Noxious Trap) shrooms placed there add poison and slow, compounding the movement denial in the contested area
tr: Anivia W duvar + R Glacial Storm slow alani, Teemo R mantarlariyla gecisi iyice kapatir

name: Fling Arena
ability_ref: Jarvan R (Cataclysm) walls a target inside an arena; Singed E (Fling) tosses a caught enemy into his W (Mega Adhesive) ground while Q (Poison Trail) burns them, keeping the grounded, slowed target inside
tr: Jarvan R arena, Singed E Fling ile dusmani W Mega Adhesive'e atip Q Poison Trail'de yakar

name: Frostfire Line
ability_ref: Anivia W (Crystallize) wall pins enemies against a chokepoint and R (Glacial Storm) slows them; Rumble lays R (The Equalizer) along the same line so the slowed, wall-blocked group sits in sustained flame damage
tr: Anivia W duvar + R slow, Rumble R The Equalizer hattiyla sikisan gruba surekli hasar

name: Soul Tether Spear
ability_ref: Yorick R (Eulogy of the Isles) summons the Maiden of the Mist plus Mist Walkers; the pets form a body wall and add chip damage while Kalista dashes around them with her passive (Martial Poise), and the Maiden's shots help her apply E (Rend) marks on grouped targets
tr: Yorick Maiden ve Mist Walker'lari body wall ve chip saglar; Kalista passive Martial Poise ile kite ederek gruplu hedeflerde E Rend stack'lerini biriktirir

name: Tentacle Tomb
ability_ref: Amumu R (Curse of the Sad Mummy) entangles (stuns) all nearby enemies; while they are locked in place Illaoi lands W (Harsh Lesson) and E (Test of Spirit) freely and her passive tentacles slam the immobilized group, with R (Leap of Faith) spawning extra tentacles for added AoE
tr: Amumu R ile stun yiyen grup, Illaoi'nin tentacle slam'leri ve R Leap of Faith'iyle serbestce dovulur

name: Withered Shockwave
ability_ref: Nasus W (Wither) heavily slows a target's movement and attack speed, keeping it from leaving the area; Orianna positions her ball on the slowed target and detonates R (Command: Shockwave) to pull enemies in, since the Withered target struggles to escape the AoE
tr: Nasus W ile yavaslatilan hedef alandan zor cikar; Orianna topunu o hedefe gonderip R Command: Shockwave ile toplar

name: Impale Convergence
ability_ref: Skarner R (Impale) suppresses and drags grabbed enemies to a chosen location; Orianna pre-places her ball where Skarner will deposit them and fires R (Command: Shockwave), collapsing the displaced targets together for a stacked AoE detonation
tr: Skarner R ile suruklenen hedefler Orianna Command: Shockwave'inin merkezine birakilir

name: Hook Into Fear
ability_ref: Thresh Q (Death Sentence) hooks and pulls a target toward the team; Urgot follows with E (Disdain) to dash and knock the target aside, then R (Fear Beyond Death) channels an execute on a low-health target and, if it kills, the corpse fears nearby enemies
tr: Thresh Q ile cekilen hedefi Urgot E knock-aside ile sabitler, dusuk canda R ile execute eder; oldururse cevreyi korkutur

name: Unstoppable Carrier
ability_ref: Olaf R Ragnarok makes him immune to crowd control so he charges into the backline; Orianna uses E Command: Protect to place her ball on Olaf, then detonates R Command: Shockwave once he reaches the carry, pulling and knocking up the cluster around him.
tr: Olaf R ile CC-immune dalisinda Orianna E Command: Protect ile topu Olaf'a koyar ve hedefe varinca R Command: Shockwave ile cluster'i toplar.

name: Unkillable Delivery
ability_ref: Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage grants large bonus health and healing to survive the dive; Orianna uses E Command: Protect to put her ball on Mundo and rides his frontline charge, then detonates R Command: Shockwave once he reaches the enemy backline.
tr: Mundo R tankligiyla Orianna topu (E Command: Protect) backline'a tasinir, oraya R Command: Shockwave atilir.

name: Demacian Justice
ability_ref: Lux E Lucent Singularity and R Final Spark deal heavy magic burst and her passive Illumination marks the target; Garen R Demacian Justice deals true damage that scales with the target's missing health, so Lux's chunk sets up a clean execute.
tr: Lux burst'u hedefin canini dusurur, Garen R missing-HP true damage ile execute eder.

name: Knock-Up And Dunk
ability_ref: Galio R Hero's Entrance knocks up enemies around an allied landing point as he lands; Darius drops into the knocked-up cluster, uses E Apprehend to pull and Q Decimate to stack Hemorrhage bleed, then executes a low-health target with R Noxian Guillotine.
tr: Galio R knockup grubuna Darius dusup E Apprehend pull + Q Decimate ile bleed bindirip R Noxian Guillotine ile dunk atar.

name: Leap Strike Bubble
ability_ref: Jax Q Leap Strike gaps onto a target and E Counter Strike stuns nearby enemies when reactivated; Orianna uses E Command: Protect to place her ball on Jax, so when he leaps in and stuns the cluster she detonates R Command: Shockwave to pull them together.
tr: Jax Q Leap Strike dalisi + E Counter Strike stun'i uzerine Orianna (E Command: Protect topu) ile R Command: Shockwave kombosu.

name: Spear And Stasis
ability_ref: Kalista's passive Martial Poise lets her dash on every attack, making her hard to pin; Taric R Cosmic Radiance grants brief invulnerability to nearby allies including Kalista, letting her keep attacking through enemy burst while Taric E Dazzle stuns chasers.
tr: Taric R Cosmic Radiance invuln + E Dazzle stun ile Kalista kite'ini guvenle surdurur.

name: Moonlight Knockup
ability_ref: Galio R Hero's Entrance knocks up a clustered enemy team as he lands; Aphelios follows up with AoE guns like Infernum and sweeps the grouped, displaced enemies with R Moonlight Vigil for stacked area damage.
tr: Galio R knockup grubuna Aphelios Infernum ve R Moonlight Vigil ile AoE yagdirir.

name: Lightning Windwall Rush
ability_ref: Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks incoming enemy projectiles, shielding Zeri from ranged poke as she kites with R Lightning Crash empowered attacks. Note Wind Wall also blocks Zeri's own Q Burst Fire projectiles if placed carelessly.
tr: Yasuo W Wind Wall Zeri'yi dusman menzil pokesinden korur, Zeri R Lightning Crash ile kite eder (kotu yerlestirilen wall Zeri'nin Q'sunu da engeller).

name: Sapling Wither Trap
ability_ref: Maokai R Nature's Grasp sends a rolling wave of brush that roots enemies caught in its path; Nasus W Wither then heavily slows the rooted carry, keeping it in the fight while Nasus stacks Q Siphoning Strike and his E Spirit Fire shreds armor.
tr: Maokai R Nature's Grasp root sonrasi Nasus W Wither ile hedef agir yavaslatilir, E Spirit Fire armor shred ekler.

name: Flip The Cluster
ability_ref: Galio R Hero's Entrance knocks up a clustered enemy team as he lands; Urgot drops into the group with R Fear Beyond Death to grab and suppress a low target, his E Disdain knocking enemies aside while W Purge shreds the cluster.
tr: Galio R knockup grubuna Urgot dusup R Fear Beyond Death ile dusuk hedefi kapip, E Disdain knock-aside ve W Purge ile cluster'i dover.
